INF=10**9

def dp(a):
    n=len(a)
    A=[None]+list(a)
    d0=[INF]*(n+1); d1=[INF]*(n+1)
    d0[0]=0
    if n>=1: d0[1]=1
    if n>=2:
        d0[2]=1+(A[1]"'!=A[2])
        d1[2]=2+(A[1]!=A[2])
    for i in range(3,n+1):
        d0[i]=min(d0[i-1]+(A[i-1]!=A[i]), d1[i-1]+(A[i-2]!=A[i]))
        d1[i]=1+min(d0[i-2]+(A[i-2]!=A[i])+(A[i-1]!=A[i]),
                    d1[i-2]+(A[i-3]!=A[i])+(A[i-1]!=A[i]))
    return min(d0[n],d1[n])

def brute_matching(a):
    n=len(a)
    best=10**9
    def rec(i, swaps):
        nonlocal best
        if i>=n:
            b=list(a)
            for p in swaps:
                b[p],b[p+1]=b[p+1],b[p]
            runs=0
            last=None
            for x in b:
                if x!=last:
                    runs+=1; last=x
            best=min(best,len(swaps)+runs)
            return
        rec(i+1, swaps)
        if i+1<n:
            swaps.append(i); rec(i+2, swaps); swaps.pop()
    rec(0,[])
    return best
